evidence.claim: Ultrack's whole-embryo DaXi tracks were never validated as ground truth. The authors proofread about 140 lineages per embryo and report that 'on average, it took 62 frames for a tracking error to appear in 50% of the lineages'. That is roughly 1.1% link errors per frame (my own conversion, a guess). Our FP rate on evaluable edges is about 5%.
evidence.source: Bragantini et al., Ultrack: pushing the limits of cell tracking across biological scales, Nature Methods 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12615266/

evidence.claim: There is precedent for scoring against computer-made references. The Cell Tracking Challenge builds 'silver truth' by majority vote over top algorithms and uses it for training. Human gold truth stays the evaluation reference. So a pseudo-GT judge needs its own calibration against real GT.
evidence.source: Maska et al., The Cell Tracking Challenge: 10 years of objective benchmarking, Nat Methods 2023, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-023-01879-y ; https://celltrackingchallenge.net/annotations/

evidence.claim: The hosts' estimated_number_of_nodes is about 0.91 x the Ultrack point count inside the clip footprint (63 reliable 44b6 clips: p10 0.765, p25 0.823, median 0.910, p75 0.948, p90 1.026). Setting N_est to the full Ultrack count, as the hypothesis proposes, would shift the node multiplier by about 10%.
evidence.source: Local computation (this study): data_external/dorado/tracks/tracks.npz + data_external/dorado/kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json + train/*.geff zarr.json

evidence.claim: Ultrack centroids sit about 0.4 um off the annotation convention in z. The Kaggle clips should be integer crops, but the registered shift_vox values have a mean fractional z part of +0.262 voxel (+0.43 um, sd 0.39 um across clips), against y +0.02 um and x +0.04 um. The mean-shift registration hides this offset on the 44b6 clips. It becomes a real bias on OOS boxes where Ultrack is taken as-is.
evidence.source: Local computation (this study) on kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json shift_vox

evidence.claim: Free space is scarce and it is all late in the movie. Counting 256x256 tiles with Kaggle-like density (44b6 clip Ultrack points per frame: p10 160, p25 224, median 393, p75 590, p90 734) and no overlap with any placed 44b6 footprint (16-voxel margin): t0=380-420, z0=64 gives 16 boxes; z0=0 and z0=320 give 8 each; t0=300-360 gives 11-15. Only 14 (t0, z-slab) windows hold 8 or more boxes. Early and mid frames are covered by 44b6 clips.
evidence.source: Local computation (this study) on tracks.npz + kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json (66 placed clips, o = 1..419)

evidence.claim: Streaming costs far more than the 1 GPU-h estimate suggests. The zarr chunks are (1,1,128,2217,2170), about 400 MB each, so a 64x256x256 box needs a z-span of the FULL XY plane (about 200-400 MB per frame). Our own extractor streamed 2-10 MB/s (about 70 s per chunk). Chunk 0 over 100 frames is about 40 GB, which yields 24 boxes: 1.3-2.2 h of download at the logged rates.

The cache-writing tools exist. tools/public_local.py runs the verbatim notebook infer stage to raw geff. stream_bundles.py writes the ckpt and DeepCenter pass-1 extras. tools/package_friend_c_b31_cache.py writes format biohub-friend-c-b31-cache-v1 (raw/dc/ckpt/divnet/train). tools/kaggle_lab.py currently forces --data-dir to the competition train directory, so a pseudo-GT directory needs a small override.
evidence.source: tools/public_local.py; experiments/local_friend_b_exp02_public_port/README.md and stream_bundles.py; tools/package_friend_c_b31_cache.py; tools/kaggle_lab.py docstring

implementation_notes: MECHANISM: the premise holds. Lab gains that trust the ILP or the edge network are in-sample: three probes with local +0.005..+0.016 gave -0.002..0 on the LB. As a judge, Ultrack is usable for continuation edges, with four corrections. (a) Set N_est = 0.91 x Ultrack points per box, not 1.0x (measured on 63 clips, IQR 0.82-0.95). (b) Subtract the global Ultrack-vs-annotation z offset of about +0.43 um (guess; estimate it by refitting the 63 clips with INTEGER shifts and taking the median GT-minus-Ultrack residual per axis). (c) Ultrack link errors are about 1%/frame, so tracklet pseudo-GT is not clean. Cut, never delete: split a tracklet wherever one step exceeds ~6 um (median true step 1.8 um; the threshold is a guess, check the 99th percentile on GT-matched Ultrack steps) or where the Ultrack track ends at a division. Under the sparse FP rule, edges leaving a GT track end or entering a GT track start are never FP, so cuts and divisions become free rather than wrong. (d) Coordinate items (float coords, coordhead) are the WORST fit for this judge: pseudo-GT position noise (median 1.29 um from GT) is the same size as the 0.3-0.8 um changes being judged. Trust it for topology items (stitch, frozen ILP-first, overlap consensus, fork-midpoint edges) and treat coordinate verdicts as sign-only. NEW, CHEAPER FIRST STAGE (no GPU, no streaming): the 63 placed 44b6 clips already have friend-A caches. Only 0.2-1.3% of their cells are annotated, so Ultrack tracklets far from every 44b6 GT node (from ANY clip, since leak groups share global GT ids) are cells whose labels neither network ever saw. Scoring existing replay configs against 'label-unseen' pseudo-GT on these clips tells us whether the optimism is label memorisation (then this is the judge, available on 25 Sep) or image-level or embryo shift (then go to Stage 1 or kill). A 'label-seen' arm (Ultrack tracklets matched to real GT within 3 um on >= 80% of frames) calibrates pseudo-GT against real GT on the same edges. PITFALLS: 44b6 clips overlap (11 leak groups), so bootstrap by leak group, not by clip. 8 clips are unplaced, which leaves residual leakage. The OOS boxes all fall in late development (t >= 300, mostly 380-520), so there is a stage shift. Before any GPU run, check pixel identity: fetch one dorado frame region at a placed clip and correlate it with the Kaggle zarr at an integer shift (expect r > 0.95 and a linear intensity map). If Kaggle preprocessed the data differently, replicate that preprocessing on the boxes. Divisions: pseudo-GT holds no forks, so report adjusted edge J only and treat the division term as unjudged. The fork-midpoint item gets an edge-side verdict only. Policy: boxes come from the public external movie outside every train footprint; no hidden test data is touched.
refined_change: Methodology only; nothing ships by itself. STAGE 0 (CPU, today to 25 Sep; replaces the proposed calibration). (1) New builder tools/pseudo_gt_dorado.py. For each reliable 44b6 clip, refit an integer shift, then map Ultrack points into clip voxels (z = pt_z/4 - shift_z; y,x = pt - shift). Clip tracks to the clip box and the 100 frames. Cut each at Ultrack divisions and at any step > 6 um. Keep pieces >= 20 frames. Tag each piece 'seen' if >= 80% of its points lie within 3 um of a GT node of ANY 44b6 clip (all placed clips mapped to dorado coordinates), 'unseen' if no point lies within 7 um of any such GT node, and drop the rest. Draw K=5 disjoint 10% samples (by points) of the unseen pieces and write each as a geff with integer coords and estimated_number_of_nodes = the host's real N_est for that clip. Write one geff of the seen pieces. (2) Add --gt-dir to experiments/l2_daughternet/replay/replay.py and tools/kaggle_lab.py (attach the pseudo-GT set as a private dataset). (3) Run the existing replay on the 63 clips for exp39, ef_a0, ef_a3_rl_pr, lp030, st_all (stitch) and float coords, scored against each arm. STAGE 1 (only if Stage 0 says the optimism is image-level). Stream dorado chunk 0 (z 0-127) for frames 420-519, about 40 GB. Cut 24 boxes: z0=64 (16) plus z0=0 (8), no overlap with any 44b6 footprint (16-voxel margin), written in Kaggle zarr layout. Friend A runs his own exact cache generator (public_local.py infer + stream_bundles extras + divnet) for exp48 and exp51 on his RTX 5070 Ti, about 1-1.5 GPU-h (a guess) plus 1.5-3 h of download. Pseudo-GT as in Stage 0, with N_est = 0.91 x the Ultrack count and the z offset subtracted.
refined_lab_test: STAGE 0 decision table (paired bootstrap over the 11 leak groups, 2000 draws). (A) Validity: on the 'seen' arm, the pseudo-GT delta for exp39-to-{ef_a0, ef_a3_rl_pr, lp030, st_all, float} must match the real-GT 44b6 delta in sign for >= 5 of 5, and in magnitude within a factor of 2 for ef_a3_rl_pr (real 44b6 +0.0145). If not, kill the whole line (Ultrack is not a usable judge). (B) Mechanism: on the 'unseen' arm, averaged over the 5 draws, if ef_a3_rl_pr is <= +0.004 and ef_a0 is <= +0.003 (both LB-consistent), then optimism is label memorisation. The unseen-arm lab becomes the gate for stitch, frozen ILP-first, overlap consensus, fork-midpoint and finals composition: +0.001 on the unseen arm with 90% CI > 0 AND >= 55% of leak groups positive. Coordinate items (float, coordhead) get a sign-only verdict. (C) If the unseen arm still shows ef_a3_rl_pr >= +0.010, run STAGE 1. On the 24 OOS boxes, apply the same rule: ef_a3_rl_pr <= +0.004 means the OOS lab is the gate; >= +0.010 means the LB failure is embryo shift or noise that dorado cannot see, so kill. Always report: per-arm deltas, adjusted edge J vs the node-multiplier split, and per density tertile (44b6 clip Ultrack points per frame: <224, 224-590, >590). Compute budget: Stage 0 pseudo-GT build is < 5 min single-process (tracks.npz is 16M points; building it on the laptop with nice -n 19 is allowed). Replay: 2-3 Kaggle CPU kernels x ~1 h. Stage 1: 40 GB streaming plus ~1-1.5 GPU-h on friend A's machine (guess).
expected_gain: 0 direct. Indirect: +0.001..+0.003 on private, from not shipping in-sample artefacts (each one cost -0.001..-0.002 on the LB) and from confirming 1-3 sub-resolution topology items for the final bundle. Stage 0 costs no GPU and 0 probes, and gives a verdict by 25 Sep. Stage 1 costs ~1-1.5 GPU-h (guess) plus 1.5-3 h of streaming and about 1 day of glue code, so it is realistic only by 26-27 Sep. Resolution is a guess: Stage 0 unseen arm has ~390 points/frame x 10% x 99 frames x 63 clips, about 240k pseudo-edges per draw, but only 11 independent leak groups, so the CI is roughly +-0.001 for stitch-sized effects. Stage 1 with 24 boxes from one slab-window (correlated) is roughly +-0.001-0.0015, not the claimed +-0.0005. Coordinate-item verdicts stay weak because pseudo-GT position noise (median 1.29 um) matches the effect size.
